summary: plan.md is written. Five white lattice arches stand in four quartz-rimmed reflecting pools in the courtyard (x 4..59, z 76..159), crown heights y 41 to y 47, the tallest over the crossing walks. Each arch has quartz ribs with end-rod lace inside. Low white wings (roofs at y 20) close the courtyard with a pointed-arch arcade and an elevated promenade. Tall ribbed boxes (y 28) whose ribs fork into pointed arches stand behind, and a 36-wide white IMAX dome sits on the north plaza. All of it reads as the white lace arches over the pools. Five white lace pointed arches (up to y47) stand in four reflecting pools in the courtyard, ringed by low and tall white lattice-walled wings with arcades, forks and rib finials. An IMAX ribbed white dome and porch sit in the plaza to the north-west. Six parts: shell, facade, arches, courtyard, dome, fittings.

parts.name: shell
parts.scope: Massing of N1, stair bay, B, B', B2, E, S, tails, W stub as white_concrete shells with floors at y0/10/18 decks, stairs (x41..44 z25..34; x80..83 z8..15; x128..130 z77..90), light_gray_concrete roof decks at y18/26; leave all OPENINGS as air.

parts.name: facade
parts.scope: Lattice bays (lattice_bay, lancet, fork_arch, tall_fork, arcade_bay) on all faces, calcite recess backs, loggia arcades on courtyard faces, coping_run at y19/27 with rib finials y20/28.

parts.name: courtyard
parts.scope: Pools with rims, quartz slab walks, 3 fountain bowls, helix at 45..47x102..104, promenade decks and columns, promenade stair x52..53 z148..156, plaza paving. Vocab: pool, walk, fountain_bowl, helix, promenade, promenade_stair, leg_plinth.

parts.name: arches
parts.scope: Five arches A1..A5 at the given coords using arch_leg, arch_frame (arch brush, pointed), arch_lace, arch_ties, globe_lamp; end_rod lattice and X crown ties.

parts.name: dome
parts.scope: IMAX dome at centre (19.5,35.5): drum y1..5, hemisphere r18 with 8 meridian ribs, 3x3 cap y23, hollow theatre interior x3..36 z19..52, porch x17..22 z54..56 with sea_lantern soffit. Vocab: dome_ribbed, porch.

parts.name: fittings
parts.scope: Iron door pairs and glazing at every opening, name band banners x39 z30..53 y12..13, blue IMAX banners, lamp posts every 8 along walks, interior lanterns, poplar rows. Vocab: door_pair, glaze_bay, name_band, lamp_post, poplar.

recruit.why: White concrete and quartz shells, piers, arcades and plinths, with lattice bays.
Pointed two-centred arches and end-rod lace, which need a steady hand with the arch brush.
A ribbed hemisphere and drum with a clean silhouette.
Door pairs, glass bays, banners and the name band.
Light every hall and every outdoor corner so nothing spawns.
